operating_notes.text: Associate Energy in Motion Limited signed an MoU with Drivn to deploy 1,000 heavy-duty electric trucks over two years.
During the year, 70,000 shares were exercised under the REL ESOP Scheme 2022 and shares were issued.
Preferential issue of ₹180 Cr raised October 16, 2024; ₹172.50 Cr utilised by Q4FY26, with ₹96 Cr into renewables and ₹46.51 Cr into the EV business.
Renewable portfolio at 29 April 2026: 228.9 MWp operating across 70 locations, 31.2 MWp under construction and 227.3 MWp under development.
Renewable generation was 194.1 million kWh for the year ended Mar-26 against 53.8 million kWh a year earlier.
Energy In Motion had 277 E-HCV sales and 34 leases in FY26, with 3 battery swap stations operating and 7 under installation.
Associate Energy in Motion commissioned India's largest heavy EV battery swapping and charging station at Nhava Sheva with 3 MW capacity.
REL guaranteed up to 50% of a ₹20 Cr TATA Capital finance-lease facility for associate Energy In Motion (REL holds 49.50%).
Board approved a rights issue of up to ₹205 Cr at ₹101 per share, 1 for every 9 held, on May 16, 2026.
Energy In Motion Ltd opened an electric heavy commercial vehicle complex at Talegaon, Pune, as phase one of a ₹1,000 Cr investment.

timeline.summary: Ravindra Energy's associate Energy in Motion signed an MoU with Drivn to deploy 1,000 electric heavy-duty trucks.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹140.16 Cr (-11.8% YoY), net profit ₹11.1 Cr (-14.0% YoY).
Ravindra Energy's Q4FY26 Reg. 32 statement shows ₹172.50 Cr of its ₹180 Cr October 2024 preferential issue utilised, with ₹6 Cr shifted from the EV to the renewables object and no deviation reported.
Ravindra Energy reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹410.15 Cr and a net profit of ₹68.21 Cr.
Ravindra Energy CEO Shantanu Lath was allotted 70,000 shares on exercise of ESOPs at ₹100 each on April 29, 2026, raising his holding to 1,20,000 shares (0.07%).
On May 3, 2026, Ravindra Energy announced that its associate Energy in Motion commenced operations at India's largest heavy EV charging station.
On May 6, 2026, Ravindra Energy disclosed a corporate guarantee in favour of TATA Capital Limited for associate Energy In Motion's lease payables, capped at 50% of a ₹20 Cr lease facility.
On May 16, 2026, Ravindra Energy's board approved a rights issue of up to ₹205 Cr at ₹101 per share in the ratio 1:9, and noted a proposal to consolidate Energy In Motion Limited into the company.
On May 27, 2026, Ravindra Energy fixed the terms of its ₹205 Cr rights issue at ₹101 per share in the ratio 1:9, with record date June 8 and issue open June 16 to June 24, 2026.
On June 3, 2026, Ravindra Energy disclosed that promoter Khandepar Investments revoked a pledge on 55 lakh shares following debt repayment.
Ravindra Energy's jointly controlled entity Energy In Motion opened an electric heavy-duty commercial vehicle complex at Talegaon, Pune.
